subject: Request: Extended pilot window due to backend migration (integration delay)
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@novaforge.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Cc: Victor Reyes <victor.reyes@novaforge.com>
Date: 2028-04-25T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot timeline impact — backend migration causing delay

Hi Chloe —

Quick note from our side: we kicked off a mandatory backend migration over the weekend (moving auth service and webhooks to a new queueing layer). It was intended to be non-disruptive but the team found an incompatibility in the webhook payload schema that blocks our connector test runs.

We were supposed to wrap the pilot by May 3, but engineering now estimates a 10–12 day delay while they roll back a library and re-run end-to-end tests.

Ask: can Redwood extend our pilot by two weeks and top up sandbox credits so we don't lose momentum once the migration is resolved? We can share the migration plan and a Jira ticket.

Attachments: novaforge-migration-plan.pdf

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Integrations, NovaForge
From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira@novaforge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline impact — backend migration causing delay

Samira — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the migration plan.

I’m looping in Marissa (revenue lead) and Dev (engineering liaison) so we can evaluate an extension and any sandbox/top-up credits. Two quick clarifying items that will help speed approvals:

- Can your engineers confirm the rollback plan ETA and that the schema change is the only blocker?
- Do you need additional seats or higher concurrency during the catch-up period?

If we get those details we’ll fast-track a proposal today.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-26T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline impact — backend migration causing delay

Quick technical summary after reviewing their migration plan and the Jira ticket (NF-1123):

- Root cause: schema mismatch introduced by auth library v3.1.2; their consumer code expects the older envelope shape.
- Workaround: rollback to v3.1.0 or apply a compatibility shim. Rollback estimated 48–72 hours dev + 24 hours QA.
- Risk: if they opt for shim instead of rollback, QA cycles may extend to ~10 days.

Recommend we:
1) Offer a 14-day extension to the pilot window,
2) Provide 200k sandbox tokens (sandbox uplift) to cover re-run cycles, and
3) Keep a dedicated Slack channel for rapid triage.

I can commit an on-call engineer for two days once they start the rollback to expedite validation.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-27T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline impact — backend migration causing delay

Chloe / Dev —

Approved: 14‑day pilot extension and 200k sandbox tokens. Please note the approval conditions:

- Tokens are for NovaForge pilot usage only and expire at the new pilot end date.
- If the blocker pushes beyond the two weeks, escalate to me with test logs and a short CTO sign-off note.
- We’ll provision a temporary higher-concurrency profile for two days during their rollback and then revert to baseline.

Chloe, please confirm and send an updated pilot timeline to Samira. I’ll ask finance to note the deal amendment (DEAL-7832) so we keep the renewal cadence unchanged.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira@novaforge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-28T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline impact — backend migration causing delay

Samira — good news: we’ve approved a 14‑day extension and a 200k sandbox token top-up. We’ll also open a short-lived higher-concurrency profile for two days during your rollback window.

Next steps for you:
- Confirm your rollback start date (we’ll reserve the higher-concurrency slot).
- Share quick smoke-test criteria so Dev can validate the end-to-end run.

I’ve attached the HubSpot amendment link with the updated timeline and the internal ticket (DEAL-7832). We’ll mark tokens to expire at the new pilot end date.

Attachments: jira-NF-1123-screenshot.png

Thanks, and we’ll be on standby for the rollback days.
—Chloe
From: Samira Khan <samira@novaforge.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Cc: Victor Reyes <victor.reyes@novaforge.com>, dev@novaforge.com
Date: 2028-04-29T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline impact — backend migration causing delay

Chloe / team — huge thank you.

Rollback scheduled to start 2028-05-01 02:00 UTC; expected QA sign-off by 2028-05-03 EOD (UTC). We’ll send a Slack invite to the Redwood on-call for midnight UTC verification during the rollback window.

Smoke-test criteria (short):
- Webhook delivery success for 500 events in staging in under 30s total wall time
- Auth handoff latency <150ms for the 95th percentile

I’ll update Jira NF-1123 with a postmortem once complete.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the extension and credits — this keeps our pilot on track.

Best,
Samira
